full_judgment:
Amirul Kabir Chowdhury, J:- This appeal on leave arises out of the judgment and order dated 22.08.1994 passed by the High Court Division in First Appeal No.57 of 1992 and cross objection tender No.227 of 1992 allowing the appeal, setting aside the judgment and decree dated 18 September 1991 passed by the Artha Rin Adalat No. 3, Dhaka in Money Suit No.132 of 1991 who dismissed the suit and dismissing the cross objection of the defendant appellant. 

 6. The High Court Division after hearing the parities passed the impugned judgment decreeing Tk. 4,81,250/- against the defendant with interest and rejecting the cross objection of the defendant. Hence is this appeal.
